Balochistan Declares Independence, Thanks Indian Media

Balochistan has declared independence from Pakistan and will celebrate its Independence Day annually on August 11. Baloch leaders expressed gratitude to Indian media for their coverage. One leader referred to Pakistan as a 'cancer'. This declaration was made on August 11.
